name: Human Rights, Liberation and Reconciliation: Nelson Mandela Legacy Sites
description: This series of fourteen sites across South Africa traces the country's 20th-century struggle against apartheid and the path toward reconciliation. It includes the Union Buildings in Pretoria, the seat of government; Sharpeville, where 69 people protesting the Pass Laws were killed; and Mqhekezweni, the Thembu chief's residence where Nelson Mandela lived as a young man. Together they link his life to ideas of non-racialism and ubuntu.
